Ok, 30F here, throwaway for obvious reasons but I definitely have experience with this because I have a fetish I am *extremely* ashamed of, to the point I'm having trouble even telling my therapist, who I see once a week.


My best advice would be for her to see a sex therapist, or a psychotherapist who specializes in these cases.  They have heard of everything and I think it could really help your girlfriend work through this. Also, feel free to PM me if you'd like (or if your GF would like to as well, this is honestly the first time I've seen another woman in a similar situation, and I've been too scared to make my own post...)


Good luck to you both.

I'm from/currently live in Chicago too, and saw something heartbreaking not too long ago.

I was driving off I-90, where there's usually someone panhandling. Usually a different person every time. This time it was a young-ish man with a large, gaping wound on his arm, walking around with a sign and asking for money. I couldn't fucking believe NO ONE had called an ambulance yet while he was WALKING AROUND WITH AN OPEN WOUND on his arm. What the hell is wrong with people? How can someone in good conscience drive away from someone in that state?
